final: WITH j AS (SELECT m.link_to_major AS major_id, mj.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member m JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id GROUP BY m.link_to_major, mj.department), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM j), sh AS (SELECT j.major_id, j.department, j.cnt, CAST(j.cnt AS REAL) / tot.total AS share FROM j CROSS JOIN tot WHERE tot.total IS NOT NULL), da AS (SELECT department, AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh GROUP BY department) SELECT sh.major_id, sh.department, sh.cnt, sh.share, sh.share - da.avg_share AS diff FROM sh JOIN da ON sh.department = da.department WHERE sh.share > da.avg_share ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
